notes: ὑδρωπικός is anarthrous, so no article competes for the supplied words of *that had the dropsy*; the whole recast clause is the adjective's under rules 31 and 17, headed on the meaning-bearing *dropsy*.
ἔμπροσθεν is rendered by a single English word, so rule 71's frame question does not arise and *before* is the head.
